Matching that behavior is a deliberate Graph Comparison detail: the Graph Renderer shows orphans as lone dots so the Barkpark and Obsidian graphs render the same disconnected content the same way. Hide orphans in one and not the other and the side-by-side stops being fair.

A freshly created Document with no Reference Field populated is an orphan until something links it — common, benign, and useful to see. Persistent orphans can hint at content that was meant to be wired into the Content Graph but never was.
